costs.unit: USD marginal per case on the owner's local host (61 rotor positions, 1,072 to 3,417 s wall with six cases sharing the host; about 17 s per position on one core alone; no cloud price applied)
USD (Gmsh runs inside the reference case)

decision.buyer: Motor and actuator suppliers (a hypothesis in #344; a magnetic component, not a qualified robotic joint).
decision.engineering_decision: Choose the magnet, airgap, slot and tooth dimensions of a surface-PM cross-section in a fixed 8-pole, 24-slot frame for mean torque against torque ripple, at a given current density and current angle.
decision.intended_use: Predict the torque at 60 rotor angles over one 15 degree period of the declared 2D magnetostatic reference (Carbon's own Gmsh and GetDP models, Brauer iron) over the DEVELOPMENT population; agreement is with that model (no end effects, eddy currents, temperature or demagnetization), not with a built machine.

design_variables.description: Pole embrace (magnet arc over pole pitch), 0.55 to 0.95.
design_variables.name: embrace

design_variables.description: Slot bottom radius, 34 to 42; the geometry must also be buildable (domain.validity).
design_variables.name: slot_bottom_mm

design_variables.description: Peak current density in the coil, 0 to 15 (an operating condition).
design_variables.name: current_density_a_mm2

design_variables.description: Current angle from the q-axis, 0 to 60 (field weakening; an operating condition).
design_variables.name: current_angle_deg

limits.basis: Reference numerical check: the torque at 15 degrees repeats the torque at 0 within this fraction of the largest |torque| (pilot worst 6.3e-5).
limits.name: check_periodicity

limits.basis: The periodicity check's absolute floor for near-zero curves; also the motoring gate's allowance.
limits.name: check_periodicity_floor

limits.basis: Relative increment at which the full Newton loop stops (ticket D3: torque agrees to 1e-11 with 1e-8 where both converge).
limits.name: newton_tolerance

limits.basis: Provisional DEVELOPMENT value: the top third of the current range, where saturation acts; the mean-torque bias is reported there, not scored.
limits.name: important_region_current_density

next_experiment: Under the Challenge Roadmap (OWNER-CHALLENGE-ROADMAP-01) this design is prior work for the magnetostatics family (f09): the miner path (CHALLENGE-MOTOR-02) and further design wait until that family reaches Prioritize after protocol lock, and then follow the common stages and suite.

outputs.description: Torque at 60 evenly spaced rotor angles over one 15 degree period, with the phase currents turning with the rotor (predicted).
outputs.name: torque_nm

outputs.description: Period-mean torque: derived by Carbon from the curve, never predicted.
outputs.name: mean_torque_nm

outputs.description: Peak-to-peak torque ripple: derived by Carbon from the curve, never predicted.
outputs.name: ripple_pk_pk_nm

pilots.note: #344's pilot shape: 8 ordinary and 4 difficult cases (deep saturation, sharpest cogging, weakest field, deepest field weakening) with 4 paired 2,880-node refinements and one 0.125 degree angle-resolution window, from public draws, on the owner's host. Two earlier attempts were stopped by the operator and left no records (ticket D3, D3a).

population.proposed: carbon.motor.development-population.v1: independent uniform draws over the eight-input box, kept when the geometry is buildable (about 91 % of the box); Q = P, w = 1. A proposed DEVELOPMENT population, not a ratified production one.

recommendation.basis: All 17 pilot cases ran OK; the 1,440-node reference is within 0.26 % of peak (0.1 % in mean torque) of the 2,880-node mesh, and 0.25 degree sampling captures the 0.125 degree curve within 8e-5 of peak. The pools are complete (150 TRAIN, 30 PRACTICE, 60 private) and both baselines are scored through the exam on the private pool: textbook closed form 0.463 (mean torque 0.165, ripple shape 0.761), kernel-ridge learned 0.214 (mean 0.038, ripple 0.391). Ripple shape is where both lose most, so the exam separates models.

reference.applicability: The declared buildable box at currents of 0 to 15 A/mm^2 and angles of 0 to 60 degrees; linear magnets (demagnetization is outside the model); 2D (no end effects). Discretization about 0.26 % of peak torque and 0.1 % in mean torque (pilot refinements); angle sampling within 8e-5 of peak.
reference.licence: GetDP and Gmsh are GPL, run on the operator host only; Carbon writes their inputs and reads their outputs; the benchmark's model files are not used or redistributed
reference.model: 2D magnetostatics in the vector potential of the GRUCAD 8-pole, 24-slot surface-PM frame (published dimensions; Carbon's own geometry and formulation), radially magnetized magnets Br 1.2 T, Brauer iron with vacuum permeability in parallel, exact rotation on a 1,440-node airgap circle, Arkkio Maxwell-stress torque; damped then full Newton to 1e-6
reference.solver: GetDP 3.5.0 and Gmsh 4.15.2 (SHA-256 checked at build) in carbon-motor-reference:dev, built from scripts/dev/motor/reference/Dockerfile; no network; one BLAS thread

unresolved: One private case of 60 is REFERENCE_INVALID on the reference's periodicity check (0.0012 against 0.001); it is charged to the reference, counted, and scored for no one.
The iron is a generic Brauer law, not a named steel; the magnets are linear, so demagnetization at deep field weakening is outside the model.
The 2D model has no end effects, eddy currents or temperature.
Miner-path integration is CHALLENGE-MOTOR-02; the registry entry stays RESERVED until then.
Every value above is a provisional DEVELOPMENT value; scientific, security and launch review are human-reserved.
